scripts.check: node --check assets/app.js && node --check assets/analytics.js && node --check data/catalog.js && node --check data/i18n.js && node --check data/capstones.js && node --check data/open-resources.js && node tools/validate_content.mjs && node tools/validate_repo_discovery.mjs
scripts.deploy:source: npm run check && npm run guard:deploy && npm run build && git push origin main
scripts.deploy:github: npm run check && node tools/guard_deploy.mjs --remote github-pages --branch main --require-main --must-clean && npm run build && git push github-pages main:main
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: node -e "console.error('Cloudflare deployment is disabled for this repository. Use npm run deploy:github.'); process.exit(1);"
